section: National Action Plan on Climate Change - the eight national missions; State Action Plans on Climate Change
subsections: New missions proposed - health, coastal, wind, waste-to-energy
Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC
Governance - Executive Committee, MoEFCC climate division

accepted.s: Which of the following was among the new missions proposed around 2015 to extend the National Action Plan on Climate Change?
accepted.x: The proposed new missions included Wind Energy, Health, Coastal Areas and Waste-to-Energy. Green Hydrogen and Nuclear missions are newer initiatives outside the original eight missions.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact item from a closely related list of climate missions.
accepted.sec: New missions proposed - health, coastal, wind, waste-to-energy

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the new missions proposed to extend the National Action Plan on Climate Change:
1. Wind Energy was among the proposed missions.
2. Health was among the proposed missions.
3. Coastal Areas was among the proposed missions.
4. Waste-to-Energy was among the proposed missions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four—Wind Energy, Health, Coastal Areas and Waste-to-Energy—were proposed as new missions around 2015.
accepted.tq: Check every item in a named list before selecting the complete combination.
accepted.sec: New missions proposed - health, coastal, wind, waste-to-energy

accepted.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025–26, which proposed new mission is counted as the ninth mission of India’s climate action framework?
accepted.x: Of the proposed new missions, only the Health Mission has been counted in the Economic Survey 2025–26 as the ninth mission.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between proposed items and the one that subsequently entered the counted mission list.
accepted.sec: New missions proposed - health, coastal, wind, waste-to-energy

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with respect to newer initiatives outside the original eight missions of the National Action Plan on Climate Change?
o: Health and Coastal Areas — advancing the net-zero goal by 2050
Nuclear and Health — constituting the original eight missions
Wind Energy and Waste-to-Energy — replacing all eight original missions
Nuclear and Green Hydrogen — advancing the net-zero goal by 2070
accepted.x: Nuclear and Green Hydrogen are newer initiatives that advance the net-zero-by-2070 objective but remain outside the original eight missions.
accepted.tq: Separate newer initiatives from the original mission framework by testing both membership and purpose.
accepted.sec: New missions proposed - health, coastal, wind, waste-to-energy

accepted.s: The Climate Change Action Programme (CCAP), launched in 2014, is primarily a scheme of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
accepted.x: CCAP is a 2014 scheme of the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC).
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-ownership trap by distinguishing the concerned ministry from neighbouring ministries.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a stated role of the Climate Change Action Programme?
o: Supporting State Action Plans on Climate Change
Serving as the National Implementing Entity for adaptation projects
Building assessment capacity on climate change
Strengthening the scientific and analytical base on climate change
accepted.x: CCAP builds capacity, supports SAPCCs and strengthens the scientific and analytical base. NABARD, not CCAP, is the National Implementing Entity for the National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change.
accepted.tq: Find the institutional function that belongs to the neighbouring climate-finance scheme rather than CCAP.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: The National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change (NAFCC) was established in which year?
accepted.x: NAFCC was established in 2015 as a central sector scheme to finance adaptation projects of States and Union Territories in vulnerable sectors.
accepted.tq: Test the year using nearby years associated with other climate programmes.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: Which organisation is the National Implementing Entity for the National Adaptation Fund for Climate Change?
accepted.x: NABARD is the National Implementing Entity for NAFCC-funded adaptation projects.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who implements this scheme?’ institutional-identification method.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: The National Clean Energy Fund was originally created from which source?
o: A levy on international air travel
A carbon tax on agricultural land
A cess on coal under the clean-energy framework
accepted.x: The National Clean Energy Fund was created in 2010–11 from a clean energy cess on coal to fund clean-energy research and projects.
accepted.tq: Link a fund to its original financing source instead of its later fiscal treatment.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: The clean energy cess that originally contributed to the National Clean Energy Fund was folded into which instrument in 2017?
o: Goods and Services Tax compensation cess
accepted.x: In 2017, the clean energy cess was folded into the GST compensation cess.
accepted.tq: Use the chronology-and-instrument distinction to identify the later fiscal change.
accepted.sec: Climate Change Action Programme and NAFCC

accepted.s: Who coordinates the policy direction set by the Prime Minister’s Council on Climate Change?
o: The National Disaster Management Authority under the Home Minister
NABARD under the Ministry of Finance
The Executive Committee on Climate Change under the Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister
The Climate Change Division under the Chief Justice of India
accepted.x: The Prime Minister’s Council on Climate Change sets policy, while the Executive Committee on Climate Change, under the Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister, coordinates it.
accepted.tq: Distinguish policy-setting authority from the body responsible for coordination.
accepted.sec: Governance - Executive Committee, MoEFCC climate division

accepted.s: Which of the following functions is performed by the Climate Change Division of the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change?
o: Serving as the nodal unit for UNFCCC negotiations and NAPCC coordination
Conducting elections to State Legislative Assemblies
accepted.x: The MoEFCC Climate Change Division is the nodal unit for UNFCCC negotiations and coordination of the National Action Plan on Climate Change.
accepted.tq: Ask which authority would logically perform the stated international and national climate-coordination functions.
accepted.sec: Governance - Executive Committee, MoEFCC climate division

accepted.s: At COP30 in Belém, Brazil, India’s National Statement was delivered on which date?
accepted.x: India’s National Statement at COP30 in Belém, Brazil, was delivered on 17 November 2025.
accepted.tq: Match the event with its precise date while separating it from dates of domestic climate initiatives.
accepted.sec: Governance - Executive Committee, MoEFCC climate division

accepted.s: The NAPCC Dashboard, launched in September 2026, is intended primarily to perform which function?
o: Replace the State Action Plans on Climate Change
accepted.x: The NAPCC Dashboard was launched in September 2026 to track the progress of the national climate missions.
accepted.tq: Infer the operational purpose directly from the name and stated function of the dashboard.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Adaptation spending as a share of India’s GDP increased from 3.7 per cent in FY16 to which level in FY22?
accepted.x: Adaptation spending rose from 3.7 per cent of GDP in FY16 to 5.6 per cent in FY22.
accepted.tq: Compare the two reported endpoints rather than selecting an intermediate distractor.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which body is associated with energy-sector measures under the Andhra Pradesh State Action Plan on Climate Change for 2025–30?
o: Andhra Pradesh State Pollution Control Board alone
Andhra Pradesh State Climate Change Commission
accepted.x: The energy-sector measures under the Andhra Pradesh State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30 are associated with the APSCCC.
accepted.tq: Use the state-specific institutional clue to distinguish Andhra Pradesh from other state climate bodies.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: A proposed response to the criticism that State Action Plans on Climate Change are weak on finance is to introduce climate budgeting through which departments?
accepted.x: The proposed remedy is climate budgeting through State Finance Departments.
accepted.tq: Identify the department whose budgeting authority matches the policy solution.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The National Action Plan on Climate Change serves as India’s domestic vehicle for which international climate commitment?
accepted.x: The NAPCC is the domestic vehicle for implementing India’s Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs).
accepted.tq: Discriminate between climate commitments and instruments belonging to other environmental agreements.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Comptroller and Auditor General flagged a shortfall of more than 90 per cent in which mission in August 2026?
accepted.x: The CAG flagged a shortfall of more than 90 per cent in the Green India Mission in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the audit finding with the specific mission rather than a similarly named climate mission.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Tamil Nadu’s climate-governance arrangements:
1. Tamil Nadu has a Governing Council on Climate Change.
2. The Governing Council is headed by the Chief Minister.
3. Tamil Nadu has a TN Green Climate Company.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Tamil Nadu has a Governing Council on Climate Change headed by the Chief Minister and also has a TN Green Climate Company.
accepted.tq: Check the composition, chairmanship and institutional counterpart separately before choosing the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
